fields.description: Issue includes extensive local political commentary on Dade County grand jury investigations and gambling enforcement, with prominent coverage of alleged irregularities in a Hialeah race ("Hialeah Scandal in 3rd Race") and discussion of Miami Beach gambling operations. Also features society/column items ("They Tell Me Things," "I'd Like to Know"), nightlife and entertainment listings and advertisements, and substantial horse-racing tips and promotions ("Jockey Jimmy"), along with a birthday-greetings feature for President Franklin D. Roosevelt supported by local businesses and organizations.
